NPR Editor Rose Friedman Dies at 38 After Cancer Battle

NPR editor Rose Friedman has died at the age of 38 after a battle with cancer. Friedman was known for her work shaping NPR's cultural coverage. Tributes have poured in from colleagues and others following the news of her death. She was partnered with Andrew Anastasi.
